summary: Fixed the off-by-one error in the do-while loop bound. The loop used `i <= intArray.length`, which allows `i` to reach 10 and access `intArray[10]` on a length-10 array, causing an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. Changed the condition to `i < intArray.length` so all valid indices 0..9 are still written while the out-of-bounds access is removed.
